notes.content:

notes.title: Deep in the Dungeon is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174565/67e215a9a7776308c8b5acf9ca2909403183af05.jpg[/img]
Prepare yourself for a test of skill and strategy in this roguelike adventure, where both monsters and items are randomly placed each time you enter the dungeon. Danger and mystery lurk around every corner, with new experiences waiting in every playthrough as the placement of monsters and treasures changes.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlock a variety of characters
[*] Randomized monsters and items in each run
[*] Shop system and skill upgrades
[*] Challenging and unique adventures every time
[/list]

Enter the dungeon today and see how far you can go!
